The NOR gate is represented by the rounded triangle symbol with the NOT function.
DISCUSSION
The NOR gate is like the OR gate except for the NOT function.
The NOT function causes the OR gate output to invert.......
The NOT function causes the OR gate to be a NOT-OR gate or NOR gate.
Each NOR gate has two or more inputs and a single output.
The function of a NOR gate is to determine when at least one input condition is TRUE. A HIGH out is available when all the inputs are LOW.
This circuit demonstrates the function of a NOR gate.......
If neither S1 NOR S2 is on, then the light is on.
Both switches must be off for the light to turn on.
When ALL inputs are LOW, the NOR gate produces a HIGH output.
If any input is HIGH, the gate produces a LOW output.......

Generally, inputs to a NOR gate are voltages or pulsed waveforms that change between two logic levels.
LOGIC LEVELS - Logic levels represent HIGH or LOW conditions. The HIGH condition is always a higher voltage than the LOW condition.
If the waveforms on A or B are HIGH, the output on X is LOW.
